rationale: ARCHITECTON evidence maturity and RDX claim evidence_level are different semantics and must never be copied numerically.

current_validator_constraints: E4+ requires at least two declared independence groups.
rdx.note: This field is pack-specific and is not the ARCHITECTON E0-E8 maturity ladder.

rules: Never convert E2 ARCHITECTON to RDX 2 by numeric identity.
Never infer ARCHITECTON E2 from literature sources alone.
A sourced claim may remain ARCHITECTON E0/E1 unless an executed calculation/test/simulation raises maturity.
Preserve source, calculation, simulation and test provenance separately.
If a valid mapping cannot be justified, set rdx_evidence_level to UNKNOWN in the normalization proposal and require review.
